replacement_policy_v1.core_rule: Nessun build di produzione (RELEASE_TAG_v1+) puo' essere prodotto se qualsiasi entry del registry audio TEST ha replace_before_release=true E audio_status != 'final_ready'.
replacement_policy_v1.audit_responsibility: Validator OPTIONAL questo pack + future PROJECT_RELEASE_GATE_AUDIT_PACK

replacement_checklist: Audio finale ha stesso audio_key del placeholder che sostituisce.
Audio finale ha stessa o simile duration_target_ms (±10%).
Audio finale rispetta volume_hint del registry o la sostituzione documenta il cambio.
Audio finale ha stesso loop flag.
Audio finale e' encoded in formato production (mp3/ogg/aac preferito; wav solo per sfx ultra-short).
Audio finale rispetta licensing canonico (no copyrighted material).
file path aggiornato se cambia da test_placeholders/ a final/.
audit query 'find_all_replace_before_release_true' deve essere zero prima del release.

final_audio_storage_layout_design.placeholder_files_deletion_audit_query: find all files in frontend/assets/audio/test_placeholders/ that have NO corresponding final entry -> block release

release_gate_blocking_rules: BLOCK RELEASE if any entry has replace_before_release=true
BLOCK RELEASE if any entry has audio_status='test_placeholder' or 'placeholder_dev'
BLOCK RELEASE if frontend/assets/audio/test_placeholders/ directory still contains files
ALLOW RELEASE if all entries have audio_status='final_ready' AND replace_before_release=false AND placeholder directory empty/removed
qa_acceptance_criteria_pre_release: Audio pauses on app background, resumes on foreground
No autoplay without user interaction (mobile platform policy)
All locked surfaces (VIP/BP/Shop/Item Shop) do NOT play audio while locked
All audio respects volume_hint or QA override
Battle hit/victory/defeat stinger latency <100ms from event trigger
Ambient loop seamless (no audible click at loop boundary)
